title: Colossal DNA test on the wolf carcass is mostly unidentifiable

tellings.quote: So we sent the DNA off to Colossal and it comes back the majority of it they can't identify.

plain: A wolf carcass found at Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah property known for reports of strange events, was DNA-tested, and most of the DNA could not be identified. Brandon Fugal, a businessman who owns the ranch, says he sent it himself to Colossal Biosciences, a gene-science company: "it comes back the majority of it they can't identify." If true, the animal would carry genetic material no one can place.
